title: JSFL: setInstanceBrightness, setInstanceTint, setElementTextAttr, setTextAttr, fl.buildNumber
description:
Add to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. fl.buildNumber: string - add to JsflFl interface as getter returning '0' (hardcoded stub, like fl.version)

2. doc.setInstanceBrightness(brightness: number): void - for each selected SymbolInstance, set colorEffect = {type: 'brightness', brightness: value}. Brightness is -100..100. Use updateDisplayObject. Add to JsflDocument interface + proxy.

3. doc.setInstanceTint(r: number, g: number, b: number, strength: number): void - for each selected SymbolInstance, set colorEffect = {type: 'tint', tintColor: rgb2hex(r,g,b), tintAmount: strength}. strength is 0..100. tintColor is '#RRGGBB' hex. Add to JsflDocument interface + proxy.

4. doc.setElementTextAttr(attrName: string, value: any): void - for each selected text object (type==='text'), update the given text property (fontFamily, fontSize, bold, italic, underline, color, align, etc.) via updateDisplayObject. Look at how moveSelectionBy works to understand the update pattern. Add to JsflDocument interface + proxy.

5. doc.setTextAttr(attrName: string, value: any): void - same as setElementTextAttr (Flash JSFL has both, they're equivalent for document-level calls)
